name: Phoenix Cable Inc
old_description: Phoenix Cable, Inc (PCI) is a privately owned manufacturer of cable and harness assemblies. We have been in business for over 28 years. We can take your supplied assembly and reverse engineer at no cost or build from a drawing to a workable first article.
about:
Phoenix Cable, Inc. (PCI) was founded in 1994 as a family-owned business in Phoenix, Arizona. The privately held company began as a local manufacturer of cable and wire harness assemblies and has since expanded its reach to serve customers globally.

PCI specializes in custom cable and wire harness assemblies, offering services that include automated wire preparation and crimping, custom cable labeling with Brady™ labels, reverse engineering of existing assemblies at no cost, and 100% inspection and testing to IPC/WHMA-A-620 standards. The company stocks a range of UL-style hook-up wire, jacketed cable from 1 to 60 pairs, coaxial cables (RG174 to RG217), flat ribbon cables, and Hi-Flex IGUS™/LAPP™ products, along with common connectors and contacts.

The company serves industries such as semiconductor, telecommunications, electronics, industrial, commercial, medical, and instrumentation. PCI has focused on semiconductor assemblies for the past 20 years, providing OEM-equivalent and custom assemblies for original equipment manufacturers and other clients worldwide.

PCI differentiates itself through reverse engineering at no charge, claimed shortest lead times in the industry, blind drop-shipping globally, and a quality system certified to ISO 9001:2015 with assemblers certified to IPC/WHMA-A-620. Membership in the Wiring Harness Manufacturers Association (WHMA) further underscores its commitment to industry standards.
